#2657 (BUG-2010) fix-up 1e13aef821: delta was in bounds, but the new test does NOT COMPILE: 3x E0716 'temporary value dropped while borrowed' in bug_2010_factory_lane_ps_tests.rs (~684 and ~777: live_agent_for_lease_or_spec(&[lane_a_final], ...) borrows a temporary array). CI Build is red. make check-ci-fast does not compile tests — run make check-ci-compile (or cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --profile agent --lib test_queue_work_respects_no_launch_for_calling_lane_attribution).
FINAL allowance: ONE more commit, compile-fix only (bind the arrays with let, as rustc suggests; no other changes). Gate unchanged: the test passes at head, FAILS with self_claim=true at queue_cmd.rs:12249 (advisor will mutation-test), Build green. Anything else, or not clean => PR parked with reason on BUG-2010.
subject: #2657 fix-up does not compile — final compile-only allowance
